content: this is a summary of a civil case heard in the panevėžys district court the court fees and professional fees were paid by the defendant the court decided to dissolve the marriage and awarded the applicant a car the defendant was ordered to pay compensation for the higher value of the property the court also declared that the debt is a joint obligation of both spouses the text discusses various aspects related to matrimonial property including obligations shares and value determination the applicant requested the dissolution of the marriage division of property and declaration of a debt owed by both spouses the defendant did not attend the hearing or file a defense the court awarded the car to the applicant and ordered the defendant to pay compensation the court also recognized the debt owed to a joint creditor the applicant was granted legal aid and exempt from certain costs while the defendant was ordered to pay the remaining costs the defendant was found at fault for damaging the applicants personal property and was ordered to pay compensation and other costs
